## Services & Expertise
- **Backend Engineering**: Designing high-throughput, scalable, microservices- and event-driven architectures with measurable SLOs, using Java (up to Java 21), Spring Boot, Kotlin, Go, and Python.
- **AI Integration**: Implementing LLM APIs, Spring AI, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and autonomous agent orchestration — including local/on-premise LLM deployments (Ollama) for strict data privacy.
- **Cloud & DevOps**: Architecting secure, scalable cloud systems on AWS (including EKS), CI/CD with GitHub Actions, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Terraform and Docker, and production observability with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana.
- **Fullstack Solutions**: Developing full-cycle applications from database schema design (PostgreSQL, Cassandra, Redis) to modern, responsive frontend components using Angular and Flutter.
- **Quality & Security**: Testcontainers-backed integration testing, OAuth2/OIDC authentication (Keycloak), GDPR-compliant architectures, and versioned database migrations (Flyway, Liquibase).

## Selected Case Studies
- **Cloud Billing SaaS**: Architected a high-performance invoice processing pipeline handling large volumes of concurrent invoice operations with continuous high availability.
- **Modular Payments Platform**: Integrated multiple payment gateways with cascade failover mechanisms and real-time transaction analytics.
- **Realtime Collaboration Service**: Designed low-latency document synchronization utilizing WebSockets and Redis caching.
- **Healthcare Integration Suite**: Built secure IoT device connectivity adhering to US healthcare regulations.
- **eCommerce Admin Toolkit**: Developed an API-first catalog management portal with customer behavior analytics.
- **Wellness Tracker App**: Created a cross-platform mobile tracker utilizing serverless cloud synchronization and push notifications.
